description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLeaveBalanceSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to specify filtering parameters for employee leave balance searches within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It extends a parent class and uses a trait for date range filtering, encapsulating employee number as a key filter criterion.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveBalanceSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee leave balance search results, including employee number as a specific filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number used as a filter parameter.
